dashboard.empty_body: Cameras you add will appear here.

live.wake_hint: Battery camera: starts only on request (uses battery and cloud quota).

viewer.hint: Arrow keys or swipe: other cameras · F: full screen · Esc: back · pinch to zoom, double-tap to reset.

accounts.title: Cloud accounts
accounts.intro: Imou cameras are reached through your free Imou developer app. Add its App ID and App Secret here; they are stored encrypted and never shown again.
accounts.none_yet: Add a cloud account first under Settings → Cloud accounts.

providers_help.generic: Any camera with RTSP or ONVIF on your network or VPN.
providers_help.bitvision: Use the NVR's IP address and the camera's channel number. The stream address is read via ONVIF.
providers_help.imou: Streams are relayed through the Imou cloud and use your developer quota.

fields_help.host: Must be a private (LAN) or VPN address.
fields_help.main_path: Optional when ONVIF is used. Example: /ch01/0
fields_help.channel: For an NVR: the camera's channel number (1 = first camera).
fields_help.data_center: Shown in the Imou developer console under My Information.

form.test_first: Run a connection test before saving.

auth.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
auth.not_authenticated: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
auth.csrf_failed: Security check failed. Reload the page and try again.
auth.bad_origin: Request blocked: it did not come from this app.
auth.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.

validation.invalid_path: Stream path must start with “/” and contain no spaces or “@”.

net.invalid_host: Not a valid IP address or host name.
net.forbidden_address: This address is not allowed (loopback, link-local or cloud metadata).
net.not_private: Only private LAN or VPN addresses are allowed. Add the network to CAMDASH_ALLOWED_CAMERA_NETWORKS if needed.
net.dns_failed: Host name could not be resolved.
net.tcp_timeout: No answer from the device. Is it powered on and reachable from the server?
net.tcp_refused: The device refused the connection on this port.

rtsp.auth_required: The camera requires a username and password.
rtsp.forbidden: The camera denied access to this stream.
rtsp.not_found: Stream path not found on the camera.
rtsp.timeout: The camera did not answer in time.

onvif.auth_failed: ONVIF sign-in failed. Check the username and password, and that ONVIF is enabled.
onvif.timeout: ONVIF did not answer in time. Check the ONVIF port.
onvif.unreachable: ONVIF service not reachable. Check the ONVIF port or enable ONVIF on the device.
onvif.bad_response: The ONVIF answer could not be read.
onvif.fault: The device rejected the ONVIF request.
onvif.no_stream_uri: The device did not report a stream address.
onvif.channel_not_found: This channel does not exist (the device has {{channels}}).

stream.path_unknown: Stream path unknown: enable ONVIF or enter the path manually.
stream.no_substream: No substream; the main stream will be used for the grid.
stream.limit_reached: Too many streams at once (max. {{max}}). Close another camera or wait.

go2rtc.unreachable: The streaming service is not running.
go2rtc.rejected: The streaming service rejected the camera.

player.mse_unsupported: This browser cannot play live video (Media Source Extensions missing). On iPhone, iOS 17.1 or newer is required.
player.codec_unsupported: This browser cannot play the camera's video format (often H.265).
player.append_failed: Video data could not be played. Reconnecting…

codec.h265_limited_browser_support: H.265 stream: many browsers cannot play it. Set this stream to H.264 in the camera settings if possible.

imou.offline: The camera is offline in the Imou cloud.
imou.sleeping: The camera is asleep; it will wake when opened.
imou.upgrading: The camera is updating its firmware.
imou.device_not_found: Imou does not know this device on your account.
imou.channel_not_found: This channel does not exist on the device.
imou.realname_required: Imou requires identity verification on your developer account before live streams can be created.
imou.not_permitted: Imou does not allow this for your app or device ({{vendor_code}}).
imou.quota_exceeded: Imou free quota reached ({{vendor_code}}). Check My Resources in the Imou developer console.
imou.auth_failed: Imou rejected the App ID / App Secret ({{vendor_code}}).
imou.timeout: The Imou cloud did not answer in time.
imou.unreachable: The Imou cloud could not be reached.
imou.http_error: The Imou cloud returned an error.
imou.bad_response: Unexpected answer from the Imou cloud.
imou.live_created_on_first_view: Cloud stream will be created when first opened (not done during the test, to save battery and quota).
imou.unexpected_stream_host: The Imou cloud returned an unexpected stream address; it was blocked.

provider.timeout: The device did not answer in time.

bitvision.default_password: This is the factory default password. Change it on the NVR first, then enter the new one.

camera.provider_immutable: The camera type cannot be changed.

account.in_use: This account is still used by cameras.
account.provider_immutable: The account type cannot be changed.
